releaseName: Category Progress Mastery Dashboard, Live Dynamic Band Score & Daily Mission Achiever

highlights: Daily Mission & Goal Achiever System: 'What do you want to achieve today?' on-startup interactive modal, 1-click goal selector chips, live progress tracker, and direct routing helper

Category Progress & Mastery Tracking: 4 dedicated live competency cards (Strategy & Core, Cambridge 4-Skills, Methodology & Drills, Tracking & System) with dynamic percentage meters and item-level completion ledgers

Live Dynamic Band Score Engine: Recalculates overall band score in real time whenever user submits Reading, Listening, Writing, Speaking, Grammar clozes, or SRS flashcards, including CEFR level mapping
Animated Band Score Toast: Real-time celebratory HUD feedback showcasing updated overall band score, CEFR progression, and practice bonuses
Refined Mobile Navigation Filter: Clean 3-tier mobile filter strip removing redundant 'All (12)' for faster touch navigation on smartphones and tablets
Full synchronization to Android APK (versionCode 4), Offline Local Engine, and website deployment
